novelty: Materially different follow-up to15-vector missing-affine residual proxy:28 recoverable inputs, complete v82 anchor, whole-v80 soft target and actual blocked taxi CV; not an unexplored source of information.

leakage.within_outer_month: Honest with respect to direct taxi-label use if all teacher and input component fits exclude the entire outer month. Student may use other days soft targets, but never held block rows or their taxi labels.
leakage.blocks: Score01..15 using fit17..end; score16..end using fit01..14. Every row receives exactly one held prediction; complete one-day embargo at split.
leakage.cross_month_warning: Do not train on July teacher while scoring January: that teacher was trained using January labels.
required_runtime_guards: Project prediction/input columns only; no eager read of y-bearing entire parquet or mixed pickle.
Persist all four coefficients and all blocked predictions before opening any true taxi target.
Preserve complete original ID/month/day alignment and exact v80/v82 controls.
Record inherited archived-original27 v4/v8 CV provenance limitation.

method.fixed_estimator: No-intercept ridge1 on version−v82 columns to teacher−v82 target; fixed source order, no scaling or penalty/feature search.
method.postprocess: Apply existing constraints before nearest-even nonnegative serialization; zero coefficients must reproduce v82 exactly. No second public correction chain.
method.selection: Teacher fidelity alone insufficient; require predeclared actual serialized v82 mean gain>=0.10, both months and paired interval gate plus independent audit.
method.affine_comparison: Prior raw28-component official-score geometry does not dominate this expanded span containing nonlinear v82. It still warns that teacher closeness is not guaranteed taxi-MSE improvement.

production_transfer.scope: One fixed all-original2026 soft-target fit; evaluate learned coefficients on independently audited final-view component vectors.
production_transfer.must_not: No shared-ID teacher lookup, no2dt target transport, no copied predictions presented as model inference.
production_transfer.limitation: Blocked same-month CV does not directly test new final-month distribution or year/refit-family change; genuine CV remains meaningful but reused development and not independent confirmation.

recommendation: Proceed only through frozen one-shot CV/input/numeric audit under root allocation; keep v82 selected fallback until every fixed gate passes. Production requires separate root release.
